heroHeadline: CDC Ends Weekly Cyclospora Updates as Indiana Closes Its Count and Congressional Letters Go Unanswered
heroSubtitle: CDC confirms it is reducing update frequency on the Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak 'as the number of new cases reported declines,' with its federal page still frozen at 11,458 confirmed illnesses across 20 states since Aug 27. Indiana closed its own count at 2,104 cases Sept 3, and by Sept 4 only 13 of the 41 states that ever published case data still maintained a public dashboard, even as food-safety attorney Bill Marler's independent fifty-state tally climbed to roughly 33,525. Marler separately reports that all thirteen congressional letters sent to CDC, FDA, HHS, and Taylor Farms since mid-July have gone unanswered, with no hearing scheduled.
